purpose: 记录 JSON Schema 2020-12 难以表达的跨字段校验与阻断项；本文件不是可执行验证器、批准制品或运行证据。

cross_field_validators.assertion: first_log <= last_log by (created_at,id) and row_count equals rows visible in the exported MVCC snapshot
entry_count == entries.length and source/backup composite version identities are unique
database_backup_id, source_environment_id, snapshot_txid_snapshot_hash and inventory_entry_count bind to the same inventory instance
each backup object is create-only, hash/size verified, and stored in an independently approved failure domain and write authority
algorithm, AAD order, nonce uniqueness, tool compatibility and key retention match one approved non-secret profile instance
expected_point_count and consistency hash equal PostgreSQL membership facts; fixed evaluation meets an approved metric and threshold
all instance hashes use RFC 8785 JCS; all Schema hashes use raw UTF-8 bytes; binary artifact hashes use raw artifact bytes
inventory publication precedes database manifest publication and neither object key/version is overwritten
network_calls == false and secret_resolution == false for diagnostic validation

open_items.title: restore input Schema missing
open_items.required_decision: 新增独立 restore-input Schema，或明确其属于哪个已批准 envelope；companion 不得冒充该 Schema。

open_items.title: versioned backup profile missing
open_items.required_decision: 定义 backup profile 的 Schema、实例 hash、工具参数和与 database manifest 的绑定字段。

open_items.title: restore result and null matrix incomplete
open_items.required_decision: 冻结 PostgreSQL、MinIO、chain、Qdrant、Redis、smoke、E2E 的精确 result object、enum 与失败/not-run/pending null 矩阵。

open_items.title: restore verification does not bind restore input
open_items.required_decision: 加入 restore_input_sha256、environment policy version/hash 与 source chain 绑定。

open_items.title: restore stage order evidence missing
open_items.required_decision: 定义每阶段 outcome、evidence、时间戳及 fork verified/service started/traffic opened 的可比较顺序。

open_items.title: Qdrant snapshot artifact and evaluation threshold missing
open_items.required_decision: 定义 snapshot artifact ref/version/hash，以及固定评测指标、阈值和通过算法。

open_items.title: MinIO encryption semantics unresolved
open_items.required_decision: 选择客户端 envelope encryption 或服务端静态加密，并据此定义 source/backup hash、size、nonce、AAD 和 envelope 元数据。

open_items.title: database manifest encryption profile binding incomplete
open_items.required_decision: 除 encryption_profile_version 外，加入 Schema raw hash 与 Profile instance JCS hash。

open_items.title: environment policy Schema and approval binding missing
open_items.required_decision: 定义 environment policy Schema，并在审批记录和 restore evidence 中绑定 version/hash。

open_items.title: companion and test-vector integrity binding missing
open_items.required_decision: 在审批完整性链中绑定 companion、正反测试向量和 package inventory 的 version/hash。

open_items.title: backup failure no-replace audit carrier missing
open_items.required_decision: 定义 database manifest 发布前失败时的 no-replace failure evidence；不得写 operation_logs。

open_items.title: canonical array ordering missing
open_items.required_decision: 冻结 inventory entries、fact counts、version mappings 和 errors 的规范排序规则。

open_items.title: critical primitive types and enums not approved
open_items.required_decision: 审批 version literal、system identifier、LSN、txid snapshot、distance metric、outcome enum、ID 和 object-key 字符集；当前 Schema 值仅为诊断候选。

open_items.title: approval and traffic-release attestation Schema missing
open_items.required_decision: 冻结 selected_decisions 结构、必需角色聚合、notes/evidence_uri 安全约束，并定义独立 traffic-release attestation；当前批准不含 production。
